zh.explain: 鱼龙混杂，都想得到高升，所以最好是耐心待在深水里等待命运亨通。机缘到来时，会不知不觉一纵身就会跳过龙门。
divination: 虽然有良好的根基，但也要静待时机。
在谋划和行动时要根据自己的实际情况，切不要胆大妄为。
items: 到达目的地的时间延迟
zh.summary: 此卦鱼龙未变之象。所祈求之事宜等待时机的到来，则可进行。

verse: A fish? A dragon? Looks different but they are the same,
Patiently they wait in deep waters for their luck to turn.
Suddenly one day, one rears its head
And in one leap, crosses the Dragon Gate.
interpretation: Even with a well-nourished foundation, one needs time to flourish.
Manage and plan your own affairs and do not be arrogant and reckless.
meaning: A fish has yet to transform into a dragon.
Everything will be in place if you only wait.
en.explain: Fish and dragons are mixed in a pond, all hoping to rise up, so it is best to be patient in the deep water and wait for your good fortune to come. When the right time comes, you will unknowingly cross the dragon gate in one leap. (i.e. gain success effortlessly).
divination: Although the foundations are strong, there is a need to wait patiently for the right timing. You must assess the actual situation before you decide to put your plans into action, do not be too bold and reckless.
items: Do not act rashly, it is advisable to be careful.
Make enough preparations well in advance
Will be favorable at year end
Protect future generations then will prosper.

notes: Both pages omit 寻失物 / 'Missing things' and include 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' (17 items). zh poem 头耸出 and jieyue 滋基 copied as printed. en uses 'Traveller'.
